assessmentName: Klamath Mountains/California High North Coast Range reference assessment
author: StreamCurves regional analysis (STAF)
revisionNotes: Reference condition is the fixed landscape-pressure screen least-disturbed-v1 (strict), wadeable non-canal frame. 18 of 26 stations of this ecoregion pass. 16 reference curves use local stations, 10 borrow from a wider region, 5 metrics use fixed criteria, and 1 metrics are withheld for insufficient reference support.
